products.title: Dell Precision 5680 16" FHD+ Laptop - i7-13700H, RTX 2000 ADA (Refurbished - Excellent)
products.body_html:
The Dell Precision 5680 is a premium mobile workstation engineered for professionals who demand power, reliability, and high-end performance. This certified business laptop is powered by an advanced Intel Core i7-13700H processor with 14 cores, a 2.4GHz base clock for energy efficiency, and 5.0GHz turbo boost for demanding applications.

The expansive 16” Full HD+ (1920 x 1200) display delivers stunning visuals with 500 nits brightness, DCI-P3 100% color accuracy, and an anti-glare coating , ensuring precision and comfort for long work sessions. The low blue light technology minimizes eye strain, making this notebook ideal for professionals in design, engineering, and content creation.

Designed for graphics-intensive workloads, the Nvidia RTX A1000 6GB GDDR6 professional graphics card accelerates rendering, AI applications, and CAD-based modeling. Backed by a high-performance 2TB PCIe Gen 4.0x4 NVMe SSD and 32GB DDR5 RAM, this Precision PC offers ultra-fast data processing and effortless multitasking.

Security is seamless with an integrated Fingerprint Scanner and FHD IR Camera with XYZ ALS (MIPI) for facial authentication. The precision-tuned quad-speaker system, consisting of two 2.5W tweeters and two 2.5W woofers, delivers immersive, studio-quality sound, while the dual-array microphones enhance voice clarity for calls and conferencing.

Built with WiFi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3 for ultra-fast and stable connectivity, this Dell notebook ensures reliable wireless performance. The UK-layout backlit keyboard provides effortless typing in any lighting condition. Running on Windows 11 Pro, this professional laptop is the ultimate mobile workstation for high-performance business and creative workloads.

products.title: Dell Precision 5690 16" FHD+ - Core Ultra 9 185H, RTX 2000 ADA (Refurbished)
products.body_html:
The Dell Precision 5690 is a high-performance 16” Mobile Workstation designed for Professional creators and Business users who need uncompromising performance in a Portable form factor. Its stunning 16-inch FullHD+ (1920 x 1200) display delivers 500 nits brightness, 100% DCI-P3 colour accuracy, and ComfortView low blue light technology for extended viewing comfort. The InfinityEdge anti-glare IPS panel offers exceptional clarity and true-to-life visuals, making it ideal for design, content creation, and Professional productivity.

Driven by an Intel Core Ultra 9 185H processor with 16 cores and 22 threads, the Dell Precision 5690 achieves excellent multitasking performance. The 2.3GHz base clock optimises battery power saving, while the 5.1GHz turbo frequency ensures maximum responsiveness for demanding Professional applications. The NVIDIA RTX 2000 Ada 8GB GDDR6 Professional Graphics Card supports AI acceleration, CUDA, and ray tracing, ensuring Certified performance for creative and technical workloads.

The integrated FullHD HDR + IR webcam with user presence detection, status light, and dual-array microphones ensures smooth communication, while quad premium speakers with 2.5W woofers and tweeters deliver clear, dynamic audio. Powered by Windows 11 Pro, the Dell Precision 5690 combines performance, reliability, and security in a Certified, Premium Mobile Workstation designed for the modern Professional.

products.title: Dell Precision T5820 Tower Workstation - Xeon W-2155, Quadro RTX 4000, 32GB (Refurbished - Good)
products.body_html:
The Dell Precision 5820 Tower Workstation is a powerful Desktop Computer designed for Business and Professional environments that require high reliability, expansion capability, and sustained Performance. Built as a scalable Tower PC, it is well suited for demanding Workstation workloads such as engineering, simulation, content creation, and data intensive tasks where stability and throughput are critical.

At the core of the system is the Intel Xeon W-2155 processor boosting up to 4.5 GHz for maximum performance. With support for 48 PCI Express lanes and Intel AVX-512, the platform delivers high bandwidth expansion and accelerated processing for compute heavy Business and Professional applications.

Graphics performance is driven by the NVIDIA Quadro RTX 4000 with 8GB memory, providing certified stability for visualization, rendering, and simulation workflows. The system supports up to four 5K monitors or two 8K monitors through three DisplayPort 1.4a outputs and USB-C, enabling expansive multi display configurations for advanced Desktop productivity.

Storage flexibility is delivered through a combination of a 2TB PCIe Gen 4.0x4 NVMe solid state drive for fast system responsiveness and two 1TB hard disk drives for high capacity data storage. Paired with 32GB DDR4 ECC memory, the Workstation ensures reliable operation, data integrity, and smooth multitasking across large Professional workloads.

products.title: Shure MXA920W-S Square Ceiling Array Microphone, Dante, PoE (Refurbished)
products.body_html: <p>The Shure MXA920W-S Square Ceiling Array Microphone is designed for professional meeting rooms, conference spaces and collaboration environments where clear, consistent voice capture is essential. Its ceiling-mounted design keeps tables free from microphones and cabling while providing discreet, wide-area audio coverage.</p> <p>The MXA920W-S supports <b>automatic or steerable coverage</b>, allowing the microphone to capture participants across defined areas of a room without the need for multiple tabletop microphones. It can operate with automatic coverage enabled or provide up to <b>8 independent transmit channels</b> when automatic coverage is disabled, giving system integrators greater control over complex room configurations.</p> <p>Professional network audio is supported through <b>Dante and AES67 digital output</b>, with <b>24-bit / 48kHz audio</b> for integration into compatible conferencing and AV systems. Built-in IntelliMix digital signal processing includes <b>automatic mixing, acoustic echo cancellation, noise reduction, automatic gain control, compression, delay and parametric EQ</b>, helping deliver intelligible speech during meetings and calls.</p> <p>The microphone connects through a standard <b>RJ45 network interface</b> using Cat5e or higher cabling and is powered using <b>Power over Ethernet, PoE Class 0</b>. This simplifies installation by carrying network connectivity and power through a single cable.</p> <p>Designed for professional ceiling installation, the square MXA920-S carries a <b>UL2043 plenum rating</b> for suitable air-handling spaces and offers IP5X dust protection. Its low-profile white finish makes it suitable for modern boardrooms, conference rooms, training spaces and professional unified communications installations.</p>
